program.section_heading: Child Development Associate Teacher Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Integrate an understanding of the needs, characteristics, and multiple influences that support optimal development in all areas of development for children from birth to age eight.
Promote partnerships between programs, teachers, families, and communities, applying ethical standards and culturally sensitive professional behavior.
Design, implement, and evaluate developmentally appropriate environments, curriculum, and teacher/child interactions, while applying the skills of observation and assessment.

notes: The catalog prints 'REQUIRED COURSES (16 UNITS)' over the whole list, including the final choice of CH DEV 172 (1 unit) OR CH DEV 084-1 AND CH DEV 084-2 (0.5 + 0.5). The 16 is recorded as total_units; the list is split into a required block (15 units) and two option blocks (1 unit each), so no block stated is set.
Catalog prints codes zero-padded (CH DEV 001, 002, 007, 010); these are treated as the closed-list CH DEV 1, 2, 7, 10.
CH DEV 011 and CH DEV 172 are not in the closed list and are marked catalog_addition.
The note about Title 22 Director (complete all core units and CH DEV 038) is an additional qualification, not a certificate requirement; CH DEV 038 is not placed.
Description mentions CH DEV 030 for infant programs and the California Child Development Permit: Associate Teacher level; no explicit career titles are named, so careers is empty.
Outcomes are printed for this certificate's own section; hyphenated line breaks were joined.
